lastCompletedStory.title: Persist merge-watch state durably across ticks in .cam-merge-watch.json

nextStoryContext: US-002 added three helpers exported from src/release/merge-watch.ts: readMergeWatchState(filePath), writeMergeWatchState(filePath, state), removeMergeWatchState(filePath). The next story (US-003) must use these helpers in makeProductionMergeWatchFn (sidecar.ts:291-350): remove the eager unlink-before-start at ~313-314, call stepMergeWatch once per tick, persist on continue with writeMergeWatchState, and call removeMergeWatchState on terminal outcomes. The outer loop in loop.ts should call the merge-watch step and then immediately proceed to hasSessionFn (non-blocking). sidecar.ts already imports MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME, MergeWatchState, runMergeWatch, GhPollFn, PrStatus from merge-watch.ts; add readMergeWatchState, writeMergeWatchState, removeMergeWatchState, stepMergeWatch, StepMergeWatchOptions to that import.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 adds durable read/write helpers using only node:fs built-ins (existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, unlinkSync). No external npm library was introduced.
